name: Product Identifier 2 Code
definition: Specifies the type of identifier of a product.

BINR.name: Buyers Item Number
BINR.definition: Product identifier assigned by the buyer.

COMD.name: Commercial Description Code Name
COMD.definition: A code to identify a product based on applicable commercial conditions.

EANC.name: EAN
EANC.definition: The unique EAN (European Article Number) code.

HRTR.name: Harmonized Tariff Code Name
HRTR.definition: Classification of goods as developed by the Customs Cooperation council.

MANI.name: Manufacturers Item Number
MANI.definition: Product identifier as assigned by the manufacturer.

MODL.name: Model Number
MODL.definition: Reference number assigned by the manufacturer to differentiate variations in similar products in a class or group.

PART.name: Part Number
PART.definition: Reference assigned by the manufacturer to a product part.

QOTA.name: Quota Category
QOTA.definition: Product identifier used by the retail industry.

STYL.name: Style Number
STYL.definition: Identification of the style of a product.

SUPI.name: Suppliers Item Number
SUPI.definition: Number assigned to an article by the supplier of that article.

UPCC.name: Universal Product Code
UPCC.definition: Number assigned to a manufacturer's product by the Product Code Council.
